title: Chapter 618
text:
Whose hunting target is Black Star?

Mad Blade's expression changed, and his face was filled with shock.

The expressions of the others also became strange. Black Star was the leader of their faction, and when they heard that someone wanted to deal with him, they felt as if they had a common enemy.

Hao Tian's eyes flashed, and he said in the channel, "We might have opened a new mission line. Mingyue, continue asking and try to trigger more hidden missions."

Sleepy Winter nodded.

"Black Star is our captain, and we will definitely deliver this list to him. However, we want to know more. Can you tell us the details of this list?"

"The people on the list are all famous individuals from all over the Shattered Star Ring," Ronaldo said with a deep voice. "They are not ordinary Grade A Supers. They are basically big shots with organizations or lone wolves who are famous for their individual strength. The goal of this group of people is to hunt and capture these powerful individuals. According to what I know, some of the people on the list have already gone missing."

"Who are the people on the list?"

Sleepy Winter followed up with another question.

"That seems to be a mysterious group. I don't know where they came from, so I'll just call them 'Hunters' for now. They're the strongest people on the list. I've only met them once. At that time, I encountered two Hunters who were extremely strong, probably at the level of A +."

Ronaldo's eyes turned serious, and he added, "My hands were broken by one of them."

"So, you're also a target of the hunters?"

"No." Ronaldo shook his head.

Sleepy Winter was stunned, and he said with a confused expression, "Then, you …"

This time, Ronaldo interrupted him and explained, "I'm an outsider who was implicated, so I only lost two hands."

After pausing for a while, he continued. "I have a friend who is also a Calamity Grade. He's the target on the list. He runs an armed organization in the Skywalker Star System and has a close relationship with the Hutt Civilization.

"A year ago, I was a guest at his headquarters. Everything was normal at first, but two hunters suddenly appeared and killed their way into the headquarters. No one could stop them. Thus, my friend and I joined forces to face the enemy. However, the two of them possessed overwhelming battle prowess, and we were utterly defeated. "

"During the battle, I used some method to steal some information from their communicators and obtained this incomplete list of names. Those two people's target was my friend, so they captured him and took him away. As for me, I was heavily injured and fell to the side."

"No matter what, I'm still a Grade A Super. I thought that they would take me away, but they didn't even look at me and just swaggered away. They don't seem to care about non-target people."

Ronaldo suddenly smiled bitterly. "It can also be said that they didn't put me in their eyes, so I escaped."

Everyone was astonished.

The goal of the hunters was to capture the strong, but they didn't take away an A-class strong who was seriously injured and had lost the ability to fight back. Was this a clear goal, or was their vision too high?

No matter what, this group of mysterious hunters seemed to be unfathomable.

"This hidden storyline is definitely not simple."

Mad Blade said in the channel.

"Although the hunters are very mysterious, the people on the list are disappearing one by one. This can't be hidden, and it means that the hunters are still on the move," Ronaldo continued. "Please be sure to pass the list to Black Star. Although I don't know him, since the Black Star Mercenaries helped me, I don't mind reminding your Army Commander."

He also had a small plan. Black Star had the Dragon Emperor behind him, so he might be able to deal with the hunters. If Black Star succeeded, he would not have to continue hiding here.

The reason he kept a low profile was because he was afraid that he would one day be on the list of hunters. Although he had only fought them once, he was already scared of them.

This time, the players' interface had a notification.

You have triggered the hidden mission [Mysterious Hunting List]!

Everyone looked at each other and nodded.

…

In a certain Star System in the Shattered Star Ring …

A spaceship with obvious signs of damage was moving at full speed like a stream of light across the dark universe.

"Warning! Warning! Fuel reserves have dropped to the warning line. Exiting hyperdrive mode in one minute, "the artificial intelligence said.

"Damn it! Those two fellows will catch up! "

Bang!

In the cockpit, Kernid was furious. He slammed his fist on the control panel with an anxious expression.

He was from a humanoid race with dark purple skin, and there were natural patterns on his skin. He wore a specially made runic armor battle suit that was a combination of mechanical and magical technology. The armor was filled with countless mysterious magic runes both inside and outside, having over a hundred types of magical functions. It was a combat equipment commonly used by interstellar mages.

However, this expensive rune armor was now in tatters. It was covered in Kernid's blood and was damaged all over.

Kernid was the strongest official of a certain Star System civilization, and he was also an honorary member of the Hidden Red Robe Abbey. He was a Mage, and his nickname was' Dark Purple Warlock '. He had a very high reputation in the Star System he was active in, but he was currently running for his life, and he had never been in such a sorry state before.

Everything was because of the two enemies that suddenly appeared.

He had been enjoying a paid vacation and traveling outside, but he had encountered two mysterious strangers. Without saying anything, they had directly attacked him, and he had started fighting in a daze.

Following which, Kernid was shocked to find that he was not a match for the two of them and was heavily injured.

Luckily, he had a trump card and managed to shake the two of them off. He boarded the spaceship and escaped, but the two mysterious enemies chased after him, and he did not dare to stop.

The fuel was quickly depleted, and the spaceship gradually slowed down. It finally left the hyperdrive mode and returned to normal flight mode.

"Sh * t!" Kernid was sweating profusely as he clenched his fists.

As soon as he said that, the buzzing sound of magic passed through the layers of cabin walls and was captured by Kernid's sharp senses. His expression changed drastically.

At the belly of the spaceship, a blue ring lit up. Following which, the ring expanded rapidly and turned into a teleportation gate. Two people walked out from it.

The two of them wore white coats of the same style, and there was no logo on them. The material of the clothes seemed to be very unique, and countless tadpole-like enchanted runes flashed on them.

The two of them, a man and a woman, both wore special alloy masks that covered their faces. The man's mask looked like a bird's head, while the woman's mask looked like a cat's.

More than ten thick ancient books floated around the man, and they were all open. They were filled with magic words and were shining with colorful magic light. The golden runes turned into a few rings and surrounded the man's body.

"The location is correct."

The man's tone was calm. He waved his finger, and the pages of one of the books suddenly flipped. The teleportation gate behind him shrunk into a dot and disappeared. He was a skilled Master Mage.

All of a sudden, the wall in front of the two of them exploded, and dozens of radiant purple lights shot out from Kernid's hands in the cockpit, piercing through the layers of walls and attacking the two uninvited guests.

He knew the strength of the two pursuers and attacked first.

Boom!

In the blink of an eye, the man changed his hand gesture, and all the books started flipping at the same time. A circle of blue magic circle enveloped him and the woman beside him, blocking all the attacks. All the purple arcs exploded into pieces of light, but they couldn't shake the circle at all.

Kernid quickly passed through the hole. His rune armor lit up with layers of light, and countless magic power gathered on his body. Like a colorful stream of light, he crashed heavily into the blue magic barrier.

He had already learned his lesson. Fighting with long-range magic was asking for humiliation, so he switched to melee combat as soon as they met.

All of Kernid's power was concentrated on one point, and the energy did not dissipate at all. His control was extremely precise. If a normal Grade A Super were to face this attack, they would choose to avoid it and would not dare to face it head-on. However, facing these two mysterious enemies, he did not have much confidence.

Dong!

The sound was like a bell being struck. The blue magic shield took this hit and exploded into countless glass shards.

"It's effective!" Kernid was overjoyed, and his confidence returned.

However, the next moment, he saw the light shining on the man and woman's masks. Their eyes were calm and indifferent, as if they were unaffected by his full power attack.

In the next moment, the shards of the magic barrier suddenly paused and fused together, turning into a brilliant bluish-white pillar of light that blasted onto Kernid's body. It was as if he was facing his own attack.

Kernid's remaining attacks were interrupted, and he was sent flying. Suppressing the pain from his injuries, he asked in shock, "What did you do?

What kind of secret technique is this? "

Just a defensive spell was able to take the full power attack of an experienced Calamity Grade Super like him. Not only was the caster unharmed, but it could also reflect all the power back at him. The effect sounded simple, but at their level, the more violent and simple the spell was, the more terrifying it was. Unlike those layers of magic shields that had 'quantitative changes', this spell was' qualitative '.

"I created it myself."

The man's words were concise, but Kernid's eyes widened in disbelief.

At this time, the woman beside him also made a move. She raised her right hand and clenched it into a fist.

Ka ka ka!

The metal twisted, and the entire spaceship let out an ear-piercing tearing sound.

The next moment, the spaceship seemed to have been crushed into a ball of paper by a large hand, turning into an irregular sphere.

Rumble —

A large amount of oxygen leaked out, and the fuel and engines of the spaceship exploded.

Flames shot out in all directions as the sphere exploded and disintegrated in an instant. All sorts of components flew out.

In just a few seconds, the spaceship turned into space trash floating in space.

A spherical magic shield protected the man and woman, allowing them to float in space. Not far away, Kernid's rune armor also flickered with the light of a shield.

The explosion of the spaceship had worsened Kernid's injuries, and his rune armor was on the verge of breaking.

Without the spaceship, there was no way to escape. Kernid's eyes were filled with despair.

Within the magic shield filled with oxygen, the woman waved her arm.

All the metal trash around them gathered again, sandwiching Kernid in the center and turning him into a huge sphere again. It was as if every inch of the sphere was under immense pressure, squeezing inwardly. The metal sphere slowly shrank, and its irregular shape gradually became round, becoming denser and denser.

At first, there was still some resistance within the sphere, but gradually, the struggle became softer and softer, and finally, there was no sound.

"Deep Purple Warlock Kernid, capture complete."

The woman said coldly.

The man took out his communicator, opened a list, crossed out Kernid's name, and said, "Shana, who should we choose as our next target?"

Shana was this woman's name. She glanced at it, tapped on it, and said, "Him, the Army Commander of the Black Star Corps."

"Hmm, he only joined the list a year ago, and his organization is developing very quickly. If not for this reason, we might not have paid attention to him … By the way, this guy is a bit special. He has the nickname of Indestructible Body, and he seems to be very difficult to deal with. If we want to deal with him, we should lure him to a suitable place and leave him alone. This requires enough preparation time, and we still have to bring Kernid back. Why don't we change our target?"

"No need. We'll split up. You send him back, and I'll deal with Black Star," Shana said calmly.

"According to the data, he only stepped into the Calamity Zone two or three years ago. Plus, he's a Mechanic. I alone am enough to deal with him."

The man paused, smiled, and said, "I almost forgot. Your ability counters Mechanics. Alright, I'll go back and submit the mission. You go and capture him on the way. Looks like we've gained quite a lot this time."
